message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data anywhere in the visible code; arguments are parsed with argparse defaults but no semantic validation is performed on the data itself.
No detected untrusted source handling: CIFAR10 is downloaded via torchvision's built-in downloader with no checksum verification, pinned revision, or authentication visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training data anywhere in the pipeline code shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code dynamically loads models via `getattr(models, self.hparams.model_type)` and supports resuming from a checkpoint path (`--resume`), but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check on any loaded weights or serialized model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation clustering, or gradient anomaly analysis.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/val/test dataloaders exist, there is no held-out test isolation enforced programmatically, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and only a single accuracy metric is used without independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (trainer.predict) receives batches directly from the dataloader with only standard torchvision transforms applied; there are no explicit shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly to metrics (e.g., softmax then accuracy) with no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated threshold checks before being returned or logged.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/classification model pipeline (CIFAR, ImageNet, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
